title: ProhibitionRecord
description: One prohibition: a pattern that must be ABSENT from every file in scope.

basis.description: The authorities this prohibition rests on.

because.description: Why this pattern is forbidden here, in one line.

directedAt.description: When the directive was given, so a reader can date the undertaking.

expansion.description:
What the scope EXPANDED TO when the record was written, sorted.

The anti-narrowing baseline. The proof re-expands `scope` and compares: a recorded file the globs no longer reach is a narrowed scope and a fatal finding, never a silent shrink.

pattern.description:
The forbidden spelling, matched as a LITERAL SUBSTRING per line.

A substring and not a regular expression, decided as a reversible call (DECISION-0007): a regex's failure modes - catastrophic backtracking, an unescaped dot silently widening the match - are exactly the silent-scope defects this kind exists to refuse, and every motivating directive is a literal class or import spelling.

scope.description: The scope, as declared: explicit paths or globs, repository-relative.

ProhibitionId.description: A prohibition: a pattern asserted ABSENT from an enumerated scope (draft S-7B).

Status.description: The lifecycle at VDS S-5(4). A directed path where skipping is forbidden.

Timestamp.description: UTC, second resolution, trailing Z. The one canonical form VDS writes.
